A story-rich printable escape room where forgotten memories, festive stalls, and a time-twisting invention come together in one unforgettable holiday mystery.

Armed only with his letters and a map of the Market, you’ll explore stalls, decode hidden clues, and gradually reactivate the components of his mysterious device — the Chrono-Camera — in hopes of restoring time and freeing his memory from a loop of eternal repetition.

Each puzzle leads to the next, revealing fragments of story and memory. It’s immersive. It’s intricate. And it’s unlike any Christmas game you’ve played before.

Teens & adults who love mystery, steampunk, or vintage-style escape games

Winter in Edelstein is quiet — but the snow remembers.
